stylePrompt: Use case: ads-marketing. One finished square Instagram carousel slide for Aaj Se Better, using attached image 1 as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its polished premium faceless young Indian creator, dark wavy hair, orange hoodie, glossy high-end 3D illustration, white workspace with subtle blue glow, orange and blue props, strong condensed stacked black/blue/orange typography. Fresh original pose and relevant scene, not copying reference content. Large bold condensed primary headline BLACK at LEFT and supplied accent headline ORANGE or BLUE at LEFT, sharply legible exact copy. Creator on RIGHT, body below headline left, clear separation from character, safe margins. Top left wordmark 'Aaj Se Better' with Better in orange; do NOT use buildkarbro mark/name. Top right outlined slide-count pill. Bottom left '@aajsebetter'; bottom right supplied note with orange underline. Tiny bottom-center tagline 'Small steps. Bigger life.'. White clean full bleed square canvas, no screenshot border or UI. Props use simple blank blocks/icons only, NO extra readable letters, numbers, labels, interface copy. Exact supplied words only, no invented text or watermark. Different pose/props illustrate message each slide, make head/body text large enough for mobile.

slides.body: Routine toot gayi toh khud ko judge mat karo. Aaj ek chhote step se dobara shuru karo.
slides.scene: creator rearranging a slipped orange habit card beside a blue calendar

slides.body: Ek din padhai, walk ya kaam miss hua. Isse tumhara poora effort zero nahi ho jata.
slides.scene: creator looking at one loose card beside a neat stack of completed cards

slides.body: Khud ko daantne mein din mat nikaalo. Bas likho: main dobara kab aur kaise shuru karunga?
slides.scene: creator writing one short plan in a notebook with blank lines

slides.body: Ek chapter mushkil lag raha hai? Ek page padho. Bada session nahi ho raha? Paanch minute do.
slides.scene: creator opening a book beside a small timer

slides.body: Missed din ki saari bharpai ek saath zaroori nahi. Aaj ka manageable kaam pehle karo.
slides.scene: creator choosing one orange work block from a larger pile

slides.body: Ek chhota action choose karo. Uska time likho. Aaj usse poora karke apna restart mark karo.
slides.scene: creator placing an orange checkmark card on a calendar

posts.caption:
Routine toot gayi toh khud ko judge mat karo. Aaj ek chhote step se dobara shuru karo.

Ek chhota action choose karo. Uska time likho. Aaj usse poora karke apna restart mark karo.

Save this + aaj restart karo.

posts.topic: Compare less, notice your own progress

slides.body: Kisi aur ki progress dekh kar apni poori journey ko judge mat karo.
slides.scene: creator looking at two different winding paths on blank icon cards

slides.body: Us post ke peeche ka time, support aur setbacks tumhe poore nahi dikhte.
slides.scene: creator holding a small picture card beside a closed notebook

slides.body: Pichhle mahine se kya seekha? Kaunsa kaam ab thoda aasaan lagta hai? Woh bhi progress hai.
slides.scene: creator comparing earlier and improved project cards without labels

slides.body: Us insaan ki kaunsi skill tum seekhna chahte ho? Ek cheez choose karo, poori life nahi.
slides.scene: creator choosing one blue skill card from a board

slides.body: Agar koi feed baar-baar tumhe distract karti hai, thoda pause lo. Apne next step par laut aao.
slides.scene: creator turning a phone face down beside an open notebook

slides.body: Ek chhoti cheez likho jisme tum better hue ho. Phir apne goal ke liye das minute do.
slides.scene: creator writing in a journal beside one orange progress block

posts.caption:
Kisi aur ki progress dekh kar apni poori journey ko judge mat karo.

Ek chhoti cheez likho jisme tum better hue ho. Phir apne goal ke liye das minute do.

Save this + apni progress likho.

posts.topic: Busy does not always mean progress

slides.body: Messages aur chhote tasks se din bhar sakta hai. Apni important priority ko bhi jagah do.
slides.scene: creator surrounded by loose message cards with one project card in focus

slides.body: Turant aaya message zaroori kaam se zyada important ho, yeh zaroori nahi.
slides.scene: creator comparing an orange priority card and blue notification cards

slides.body: Aaj din ke end tak kya complete karna hai? Ek clear finish line likho.
slides.scene: creator placing one finished block on a clean desk

slides.body: Apni important priority ke liye ek chhota time slot rakho. Us waqt extra tabs band karo.
slides.scene: creator closing distractions beside one open notebook and timer

slides.body: Tasks tick hue, par useful kaam kitna complete hua? Dono ko alag se dekho.
slides.scene: creator inspecting a finished project beside a checklist

slides.body: Ek useful result choose karo. Uska agla step likho. Calendar mein uske liye waqt rakho.
slides.note: Save this + ek priority set karo.
slides.scene: creator placing an orange task card beside a blank calendar

posts.caption:
Messages aur chhote tasks se din bhar sakta hai. Apni important priority ko bhi jagah do.

Ek useful result choose karo. Uska agla step likho. Calendar mein uske liye waqt rakho.

slides.body: Dusron ki help achhi baat hai. Apni capacity samajh kar commitment dena bhi zaroori hai.
slides.scene: creator holding several requests beside a small calendar

slides.body: Naya kaam lene se pehle check karo: time hai? Energy hai? Purane commitments ka kya hoga?
slides.scene: creator looking at filled calendar blocks beside one new request

slides.body: Agar sure nahi ho, bolo: main apna schedule check karke tumhe bata deta hoon.
slides.note: Jawab dene ke liye waqt lo.
slides.scene: creator pausing thoughtfully beside a message card and clock

slides.body: Abhi main yeh nahi le paunga. Chhota, respectful aur saaf jawab kaafi ho sakta hai.
slides.scene: creator placing one request card into a separate tray

slides.body: Agar genuinely possible ho, doosra time suggest karo. Sirf guilt mein naya promise mat karo.
slides.scene: creator considering two calendar slots with simple blocks

slides.body: Kaam, phone ya extra requests mein ek limit choose karo. Use calmly aur clearly communicate karo.
slides.scene: creator protecting an orange calendar block with a clear divider

posts.caption:
Dusron ki help achhi baat hai. Apni capacity samajh kar commitment dena bhi zaroori hai.

Kaam, phone ya extra requests mein ek limit choose karo. Use calmly aur clearly communicate karo.

Save this + apna waqt bachao.

slides.body: Ek mistake ko apni poori identity mat banao. Kaam ko review karo, khud ko label mat karo.
slides.scene: creator inspecting one flawed work card beside other useful work

slides.body: Kabhi aur hamesha jaise words check karo. Kya tumhare paas iske against koi example bhi hai?
slides.scene: creator comparing two unlabelled thought cards

slides.body: Deadline miss hui ek fact hai. Main useless hoon ek label hai. Dono ko alag likho.
slides.scene: creator separating one calendar card from a cloudy thought card

slides.body: Wahi situation dost ke saath hoti toh kya kehte? Apne liye bhi fair words choose karo.
slides.scene: creator holding a supportive orange message card

slides.body: Ek reason samjho aur ek practical change choose karo. Sirf khud ko blame karne se aage badho.
slides.scene: creator moving one improvement card beside a notebook

slides.body: Main bekaar hoon ki jagah likho: is kaam mein dikkat aayi. Ab main yeh step try karunga.
slides.scene: creator rewriting a note beside an orange pencil

posts.caption:
Ek mistake ko apni poori identity mat banao. Kaam ko review karo, khud ko label mat karo.

Main bekaar hoon ki jagah likho: is kaam mein dikkat aayi. Ab main yeh step try karunga.

Save this + ek label badlo.

posts.topic: Keep one small promise to yourself

slides.body: Aaj ek aisa commitment choose karo jo tumhari real routine mein fit ho.
slides.scene: creator choosing one small orange block beside a larger stack

slides.body: Better banna vague hai. Dinner ke baad ek page padhna ek clear action hai.
slides.scene: creator opening a book beside a simple task card

slides.body: Kab karoge? Kahan karoge? Apne action ko ek daily moment ke saath jodo.
slides.scene: creator placing a book beside a clock and desk lamp

slides.body: Poora session nahi ho raha toh minimum kya kar sakte ho? Uska chhota version pehle decide karo.
slides.scene: creator choosing a small book card beside a larger notebook

slides.body: Action hua ya nahi, honestly note karo. Miss hua toh reason samjho aur agla attempt plan karo.
slides.scene: creator marking abstract calendar blocks with a pencil

slides.body: Ek action, ek time aur ek minimum version. Aaj usse try karo aur apna outcome note karo.
slides.scene: creator arranging three icon cards beside an orange checkmark

posts.caption:
Aaj ek aisa commitment choose karo jo tumhari real routine mein fit ho.

Ek action, ek time aur ek minimum version. Aaj usse try karo aur apna outcome note karo.

Save this + chhota promise nibhao.

slides.body: Sab kuch ek saath badalne ki zaroorat nahi. Agle hafte ke liye ek useful adjustment choose karo.
slides.scene: creator reviewing a notebook beside one orange calendar block

slides.body: Teen chhoti cheezein likho jo tumne ki. Sirf unfinished list par nazar mat rakho.
slides.note: Finished work bhi count hota hai.
slides.scene: creator gathering three completed cards into a notebook

slides.body: Kaunsa task baar-baar delay hua? Kya next step unclear tha ya time slot realistic nahi tha?
slides.scene: creator inspecting a stalled task card beside a small gear

slides.body: Kaunsi habit ya decision useful raha? Har week naya system shuru karna zaroori nahi.
slides.scene: creator choosing one helpful tool card beside a notebook

slides.body: Agle hafte ke teen important results likho. Har ek ka pehla manageable step bhi add karo.
slides.scene: creator arranging three project blocks beside a calendar

slides.body: Aaj das minute review ko do. Ek improvement choose karo aur uska pehla step schedule karo.
slides.note: Save this + apna weekly reset karo.
